subject.title: [Bug] Telegram inbound images download but are not passed to model as vision input

question: Should current-turn media delivery forward partial native images when some same-turn attachments fail, or preserve the current all-or-nothing fallback until a richer alignment contract exists?
rationale: Current main already has a tested simple native-image path, but the open closing PR changes partial-media semantics in a shared message-delivery path and prior review found source-alignment/proof blockers.

options.title: Repair aligned partial delivery
options.body: Allow partial native forwarding only after preserving failed attachment positions through the downstream prompt-image boundary and collecting real Telegram or equivalent transport proof.

options.title: Keep fallback behavior
options.body: Preserve the current all-or-nothing fallback and close or narrow the linked PR if partial native delivery is not the intended contract.

options.title: Close after live proof of current main
options.body: If maintainers decide the original single-image report is already solved, collect live current-main proof, close the linked PR as unnecessary, and then close this issue as implemented.

recommendation.title: Repair aligned partial delivery
recommendation.body: Allow partial native forwarding only after preserving failed attachment positions through the downstream prompt-image boundary and collecting real Telegram or equivalent transport proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the freshest merged image-order contract change in the same resolver, so they are the best available routing candidate for this contract choice.
